Norway / CITY EDIT

Ten cities to start with.

Compare the city guide ↗
01 / Norway

Oslo

Norway's capital combines contemporary waterfront architecture with museums and outdoor sculpture.

Explore Oslo ↗02 / Norway

Bergen

Bergen's historic trading waterfront sits between mountain slopes and Norway's western fjords.

Explore Bergen ↗03 / Norway

Tromsø

Tromsø pairs Arctic exploration history with a lively city centre surrounded by mountains and fjords.

Explore Tromsø ↗04 / Norway

Trondheim

Trondheim brings together medieval pilgrimage heritage and colourful wooden neighbourhoods along the Nidelva.

Explore Trondheim ↗05 / Norway

Stavanger

Stavanger combines preserved wooden streets with museums exploring Norway's offshore oil industry.

Explore Stavanger ↗06 / Norway

Ålesund

Ålesund's Art Nouveau streets spread across coastal islands beneath the Aksla viewpoint.

Explore Ålesund ↗07 / Norway

Bodø

Bodø combines northern coastal culture with aviation history and access to powerful tidal currents nearby.

Explore Bodø ↗08 / Norway

Kristiansand

Kristiansand pairs southern Norway's seaside atmosphere with a historic quarter of white wooden houses.

Explore Kristiansand ↗09 / Norway

Lillehammer

Lillehammer combines traditional Norwegian buildings with the sporting legacy of the 1994 Winter Olympics.

Explore Lillehammer ↗10 / Norway

Fredrikstad

Fredrikstad's fortified old town preserves cobbled streets and historic buildings beside the Glomma.

Explore Fredrikstad ↗
